brief.headline: Lead with supply security and a backup plan — they're in the distress zone (-0.18 Altman Z) — then ask to match our best price (₹1.62/NOS) and offer faster payment (15 days) for a 2.8% discount

priceAsk.summary: Match our best price of ₹1.62/NOS on the LDPE bottle and close the ₹3.37 L/yr gap
priceAsk.target: ₹1.62/NOS (our best price from Bprex) — a 4.3% reduction from their ₹1.69/NOS
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹1.62/NOS to Bprex Pharma Packaging India (P) Limited for the same LDPE BOTTLE 5ML WHITE OPAQUE. Berry is 100.0% a trader — they're reselling, not making — so their price carries a margin we shouldn't pay. The market ask for similar caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume, confirming room to move.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days (instead of 30) in exchange for a 2.8% price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹3.34 L of our cash — but their cash is stuck for 335d (far longer than the 70d similar firms see), so getting paid 15 days early is worth roughly their borrowing cost of 2.77% to them; we offer it for a matching discount

brief.financialLeverage: Berry is in serious trouble: they lost ₹-22.50 Cr in FY2023-24 (keeping -199.2% of every rupee they sold, vs 2.3% for similar firms), their distress score is -0.18 (distress zone), and they owe 220.44x their own cash. Our ₹81.39 L is 7.21% of their ₹11.29 Cr revenue — a real chunk — so they need us. But pushing too hard on price alone could tip them over. The smarter play: lead with qualifying a second source (Manjushree or Mold-Tek) and securing our supply, then frame the ask as 'match our best price and we'll pay you faster to help your cash' — not a squeeze, a deal that keeps them alive and us covered.

evidence.point: They are in the distress zone

evidence.figure: Final profit: ₹-22.50 Cr; they keep: -199.2% vs similar firms: 2.3%

evidence.point: We're a big customer — over 7% of everything they sell
evidence.figure: Our ₹81.39 L is 7.21% of their ₹11.29 Cr revenue

evidence.point: Their cash is stuck far longer than rivals
evidence.figure: Cash stuck for: 335d vs similar firms: 70d

evidence.point: We pay them 4.3% more than our cheapest source on the main bottle SKU
evidence.figure: Their price ₹1.69/NOS vs our best ₹1.62/NOS (Bprex); gap: 4.3%; yearly excess: ₹3.37 L

evidence.point: They are a pure trader — not a manufacturer
evidence.figure: Manufactured: 0.0%, Traded: 100.0% — their price has a reseller margin baked in

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; the strongest second-source candidate to cover Berry's risk

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) for pails, containers, pharma — a robust, profitable alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded and blow-moulded packaging specialist (₹701.17 Cr revenue, health C 51/100) with broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: Berry's distress score (-0.18, distress zone) and massive loss (₹-22.50 Cr) mean supply could dry up — don't load more volume onto them until you've qualified Manjushree or Mold-Tek and have a signed backup agreement
They owe 220.44x their own cash (₹172.48 Cr total debt) — even a small hiccup in their sales or collections could freeze operations, leaving us short
Their financial-health score is 1/10 and they're burning cash (₹-164.97 Cr free cash flow) — this isn't a stable partner for the long term; plan a 12-month transition to a stronger source
Pushing a hard price cut without offering faster payment or a volume commitment could be the final straw — frame every ask as helping their cash, not just squeezing margin
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but with your financials under pressure we need to line up a second source to protect our supply — and we'd like to help your cash flow by paying faster if you can match the ₹1.62/NOS we already pay Bprex.
